scientific_integrity: Fourier transform, Zak normalization and both sharp bound extrema are stated; finite numerical tests are not used as proof of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Exact upper bound at the balanced offset; arbitrary offsets have a one-variable variational characterization, not a general closed upper formula. Fixed integer modulation and two time-translation cosets only. Historical priority and independent proof validation outstanding.
title: Exact staggered-translation Gabor bounds for the Poisson kernel
